name: vscode-gauntletui-lsp
description: IntelliSense and support for Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord GauntletUI prefabs.

gauntletui.gamePath.description: Path to Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord game folder (contains bin and modules).

gauntletui.schemaPath.description: Path to custom generated gauntlet-schema.json file. If empty, the extension will generate one or use workspace root's schema.

gauntletui.fileGlob.description: Glob pattern for GauntletUI XML prefab files to activate on.

gauntletui.viewModelMapping.description: Mapping from prefab file names to ViewModel class names, e.g. { "ClanScreen": "ClanVM" }.

gauntletui.diagnosticsEnabled.description: Enable basic diagnostics/validation for tags and attributes.
